QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). Neither `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` nor `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` is enabled either (lines 2185, 2196)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves THREADING_C commented out and neither PTHREAD nor ALT enabled, so a default build defines none of them. The item asks for the two threading macros, and PTHREAD and ALT are the ones that matter here.
